plan.notes: Source: University of North Florida official Osprey Map (term-by-term sample schedule) for Electrical Engineering, https://www.unf.edu/catalog/ospreymaps/2025-2026/Electrical-Engineering.html, retrieved 2026-10-09. UNF describes the Osprey Map as a sample schedule (not a contract) to be used with an academic advisor; mile-marker courses should be completed before/by the end of that term. CATALOG YEAR: the map is published under UNF's 2024-2025 Osprey Maps path and the page states 'Effective Term: Fall 2024'; the byte-identical page is also served at the 2025-2026 path (UNF has not published newer maps) — recorded as catalog_year 2024-2025. Terms transcribed as Year N Fall/Spring (UNF labels them Terms 1-8; sequence assumes fall start). Summer advisory tables are suggestions only (catch-up/get-ahead options) and are not sequenced. Credit ranges printed on some rows resolved at the catalog minimum per collection standard; UNF declares Total Program Hours: 120 — sequence sums to 110 at minimum elective credits, and free-elective rows carry UNF's note 'If needed for 120 total hours'. Osprey Maps do not publish per-course enrollment prerequisites; mile markers below are progression milestones (minimum grade C). Mile markers: Term 1: Attempted Hours 0-15: ENC1101 (GW) Audience and Purpose Minimum Grade C COP2220 Computer Science I Minimum Grade C MAC2311 Calculus I Minimum Grade C CHM2045 General Chemistry I Minimum Grade C EGN1001C Intro to Engineering I Minimum Grade C | Term 2: Attempted Hours 16-30: MAC2312 Calculus II Minimum Grade C PHY2048C Calculus-Based Physics I Minimum Grade C EEL3013 Modeling and Sim in EE Minimum Grade C | Summer 1: ENC3246 Prof. Comm: Engineering OR ENC2463 (GW) Writing Topics: Engineering Minimum Grade C | Term 3: Attempted Hours 31-45: MAC2313 Calculus III Minimum Grade C PHY2049/2049L Calculus-Based Physics II Minimum Grade C EEL3701 Intro to Digital Systems Minimum Grade C EEL3701L Intro to Digital Systems Lab Minimum Grade C | Term 4: Attempted Hours 46-60: MAP2302 Ordinary Differ Equations Minimum Grade C EEL3111 Circuit Analysis I Minimum Grade C STA4321 (GM)Probability and Statistics Minimum Grade C EEL4744C Microcontroller Applications Minimum Grade C | Summer 2: MAS3105 (GM) Linear Algebra Minimum Grade C | Term 5: Attempted Hours 61-75: EEL3117L Electrical Circuits Laboratory Minimum Grade C EEL3112 Circuit Analysis II Minimum Grade C EEL3216 Introduction to Power Systems Minimum Grade C EEE3308 Microelectronics I Minimum Grade C Civic Literacy Requirement | Term 6: Attempted Hours 76-90: EEL3135 Signals and Systems Minimum Grade C EEE4309 Microelectronics II Minimum Grade C EEE4309L Electronics Lab Minimum Grade C EEL3472 Electromagnetic Fields Applic Minimum Grade C | Term 7: Attempted Hours 91-105: EEL4657 Linear Control Systems Minimum Grade C EEL4657L Linear Control Systems Lab Minimum Grade C EEL4514 Communication Systems Minimum Grade C EEL4514L Communication Systems Lab Minimum Grade C EEL4914 Senior Capstone Design I Minimum Grade C.
